Automation: Rules reference · play automation in progress

You notice the untouched cup, the worried glance, the detail everyone else stepped past.

Rules

Action
Main Action
Attribute
Reason
Time
One minute.
Target / range / shape
An accessible scene or person you can examine; one minute
Duration
Information and earned progress persist for the stated task; completed changes remain until circumstances alter them.
Equipment / acquisition
None.
Limits
Repeatable; pay the action and any stated costs each use.
Type
Skill / Utility

No secret fact is invented. Obvious clues require no roll. This grants no lie detection, mind reading or an Observation attribute.

Weak
Learn one visible detail relevant to your stated question.
Standard
Also identify a plausible interpretation.
Strong
Also identify a concrete way to check that interpretation.
